rationale: The agent performed write actions (initiated returns and modified a pending order item) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The tool calls show return_delivered_order_items executed for two items on order #W6239298 and one item on #W9218746, and modify_pending_order_items on #W4860251, all without an intervening confirmation step. Additionally, the user requested changing the shipping address to their default Chicago home, but there is no evidence of any address update action. There is also potential mismatch with the instruction that the bookshelf and jigsaw were from different orders, whereas the returns were processed together on the same order (#W6239298). While the agent did look up the user via email and retrieved order details, the lack of confirmation before writes and incomplete fulfillment (no address update, unclear handling of the tracking-number request) mean the request was not completed in compliance with policy.
